name: EPIC 245990752
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 4.8 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245990752 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 4.77291 (16th-84th percentiles 4.636905-4.930074), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245990752 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.940531 (16th-84th percentiles 0.87739-1.016213), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245990752: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4782.096 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245990752 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1335.839844 (16th-84th percentiles 1301.386719-1372.753906), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.02 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,336 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.94 solar masses and 4.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,782 K at its surface.
